themes.scene: Elevated drone photograph from above and in front at about 45 degrees, showing the whole house, its roof and its entire plot including the back garden, with a little space around the boundaries
bases: Country Cottage|Stone walls and roses|a small detached stone cottage with a slate roof and climbing roses, in the middle of a large plot of open lawn with hedges around the edge
Lakefront Cabin|A timber cabin by the water|a single-storey timber cabin with a covered porch on a wide grassy plot sloping down to a calm lake, pine trees at the far edge

Contemporary Villa|Clean white lines and big glass doors|a modern two-storey white-rendered villa with flat roofs and large glass doors, in the middle of a wide flat lawn in a sunny Mediterranean setting
Large Detached House|Red brick on a leafy avenue|a large red-brick detached family house with a gravel drive, set in a big flat garden of open lawn with mature trees along the boundary
Seaside Bungalow|Single storey, sea breeze|a white single-storey bungalow with a blue front door on a wide grassy clifftop plot, the sea in the background
Converted Barn|Oak beams and open fields|a converted timber-clad barn with a pitched roof and a tall glazed entrance, surrounded by a large open paddock of grass
Country Manor|Ivy, chimneys and parkland|a grand Georgian manor house in honey-coloured stone with sash windows and chimneys, in the middle of wide open parkland lawns
Mansion on a Hill|Views from the top|a large modern white mansion with glass walls on top of a broad green hill, with wide open lawns all around it
Beachside House|Steps from the sand|a modern timber-and-glass beach house on a wide flat plot of dune grass, with a sandy beach and the sea behind
Alpine Chalet|Snowy peaks and a wood burner|a traditional wooden alpine chalet with a steep roof and balconies on a wide gently sloping meadow, snowy mountains behind
Modern Farmhouse|Black barn style|a modern black-clad farmhouse with a pitched metal roof, in the middle of a large flat field of open lawn with a few trees
Scandinavian Lodge|Pale timber in the pines|a pale timber Scandinavian-style lodge with big windows in a large forest clearing of open grass
Georgian Rectory|Red brick and symmetry|a symmetrical red-brick Georgian rectory with white sash windows, surrounded by a large walled garden of open lawn
Desert Villa|Concrete and glass in the sun|a low concrete-and-glass modernist villa on a wide flat plot of pale gravel and lawn, desert hills behind

Tarpaulin Roof|Leaks in every room|a torn blue tarpaulin weighed down with bricks covering a big hole in the roof
Rusty Caravan|Abandoned by a cousin|a rusty abandoned caravan with flat tyres parked on the lawn

Burnt-out Car|Not going anywhere|a burnt-out rusty car shell on bricks on the driveway

Scaffolding|Up for years|rusty scaffolding with sagging green netting covering the front of the house
